title: designc record envelope
description: One envelope for decisions, requirements, verdicts, procedures and test scenarios (intelligence plane phase 2). renderer/records.js validates it and python/designc/records.py mirrors it. Lint across records (repeated ids, unknown or superseded references) is in Records.lint. A string check's id is 'chk-' plus the first 8 hex digits of hash16 of the trimmed command. minted and checked read as proposed.

ref.description: A bare id is another record. A prefixed id points outside: ui:, req:, el:, test:, jira:

oneOf.description: A shell command run in the registry folder

options.description: The options considered before deciding, each a short phrase

enforced_by.description: Check ids (chk-..., or an {id, run} check's id), gate:<clause kind>, or mlang:<rule id>

oneOf.title: test_scenario
oneOf.description: test-scenarios/<id>.yaml: one case that proves part of a requirement, written by an agent from the requirement's page or by QA. The requirement must be a requirement record (Records.lint). Flat: given, when and then are lists of sentences. Structured (any of screen, steps, effect): screen, steps and effect.operation are required, given may be a mapping of data, when and then are optional. status is minted or bound; a person binds. Display only, never a gate input until B4.

run.description: C5: the extraction run that minted this case (for example a or b); variance compares two runs per page sentence

source.description: The sentence of the requirement page this case comes from, verbatim

questions.description: What the page does not settle; any open question blocks binding

given.description: Seed rows (C4): entity (pack aggregate) -> rows, field -> literal value

then.description: Expected rows after the call (C4), matched on the listed fields only

request.description: C4b: the call's inputs for the API test. path and query values are literal scalars; body only when effect.body is absent

oneOf.title: procedure
oneOf.description: procedures/*.yaml, written by a person. The bound ones whose el: scope touches an agent's elements go into its context bundle; a trace row names those used as {id, version, hash}, hash being hash16 of the file text with CRLF read as LF.
